scope: Dedicated remainingNECA mask research. No generation, source/raster edits or repository writes by this research agent. Neutral rendering C handled separately by parent.

discoveryMethod.description: Open actual publisher-linked attachment pages. Their displayed gallery image URLs use refused CDN, but publisher-authored Pinterest share anchors contain an encoded media= URL directly on allowed necaonline.com. Decode the exact parameter using urllib.parse.parse_qs; request only that independently published original URL. No CDN hostname/path replacement, no share-service request, no image proxy.
discoveryMethod.literalEvidence: Every downloaded photo stores rawPublisherAnchorTag, publisherShareHref, decodedPublishedImageURL and sourceHTML SHA. Raw anchor membership and exact decoded parameter equality were asserted.
discoveryMethod.refusalLimits: Do not derive absent attachment permalinks or guess alternate image filenames from known CDN URLs.
